mapper.select: SELECT FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id} AND membership_id=#{member}
SELECT FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND membership_id=#{member} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND membership_id=#{member}
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET status='RUNNING',heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id} AND status='WAITING'
UPDATE forge_io_task SET heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_count=#{rows},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING')

UPDATE forge_io_task SET status=#{status},row_count=#{rows},error_code=#{code},failure_reason=#{reason},result_object_id=#{result},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id,type,source_object_id,created_by,row_count,query_summary FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING') AND heartbeat_at < #{cutoff} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET status='FAILED',error_code='io.interrupted',failure_reason='执行中断，请重新提交',finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING') AND heartbeat_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND result_object_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET result_object_id=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id}
